# Archive fixtures

`deflated-utf8.zip` is synthetic test data generated with Python standard-library
`zipfile`, independently of the Rust ZIP implementation. It contains
`RJ123456/音声/説明.txt`, Deflate-compressed UTF-8 text consisting of
`日本語のファイル名とDeflate圧縮。\n` repeated 32 times. Its timestamp is fixed at
2026-01-01 00:00:00. No downloaded/user content is included.

Issue #50 filename fixtures are generated by
`python3 crates/dm-archive/tests/fixtures/generate-filename-zips.py`. They use
handwritten stored ZIP headers, fixed timestamps, and `hello` payloads:

- `cp932.zip`: unflagged CP932 names, including 0x5C trail bytes and an
  extensionless `表` file (must not be misclassified as a directory).
- `unflagged-utf8.zip`: valid UTF-8 without its flag; these bytes are invalid
  CP932 and must fail under the explicit CP932-only policy for unlabeled names.
- `unicode-path.zip`: a CRC-valid Unicode Path extra field overrides a
  different CP932 header name.
- `invalid-filename.zip`: a valid entry followed by an incomplete CP932 lead
  byte, testing error cleanup after partial staging.
- `invalid-flagged-utf8.zip`: CP932 bytes falsely marked UTF-8; explicit
  UTF-8 must fail strictly rather than falling back.
- `cp932-{traversal,backslash,absolute}.zip`: valid CP932 names containing
  unsafe paths, which must still be rejected after decoding.
